description:
[measured] Resting limit orders over time on ONE exchange: cells of (time bucket, price
    bucket, quantity in coins) from archived order-book snapshots, with price_min, price_max,
    price_step and time_step (seconds) describing the grid. Shows where bid and ask walls
    stood and when they were pulled; not liquidations (see get_liquidation_heatmap for
    those) and not trades (get_footprint). exchange: binance | bybit | okx. symbol: BTCUSDT,
    ETHUSDT or SOLUSDT only. minutes: 1 to 1440.

exchange.description: Venue id (binance, bybit, okx, bitget, hyperliquid, gate, htx, kucoin, mexc, bingx, aster, kraken, gmx) or 'all' where the tool allows it.
exchange.title: Exchange

symbol.description: Contract as BASEUSDT, e.g. BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT (1000PEPE and kPEPE fold to PEPEUSDT).
symbol.title: Symbol
